profile.headline: Software Engineer at John Deere
profile.summary:
Pending update…


Professional Experience
•8 years of IT experience in numerous atmospheres and environments
•Knowledgeable in C++, JAVA, COBOL, HTML and basic web design
•Fluent with Microsoft Office 2003, Office 2007, and Open Office 
•Experienced in Windows 2000, XP, Vista, 7, Mac OS X, AIX 5.3, AIX 6.1, IBM VIO, IBM HACMP, Red Hat Linux 4, 5,  6, and Cent OS
•Familiar with HP Data Protector, Tivoli Storage Manager Server 5 and 6, Acronis True Image  


Goals
•Work for a company that is involved with the community and is respected by it

Specialties: •UNIX, Linux, Windows
•System Backups via IBM NIM, TSM, and Imaging software such as Acronis True image

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Manage 60+ Kubernetes clusters at numerous locations around the world and at AWS. Clusters were managed using Cluster API and providers for Nutanix, vSphere, and AWS. Supported both dedicated and multi-tenant models. Used GitHub Actions for CI/CD workflows to deploy in house operators,  30+ open source software suites, and to kick of new cluster builds.

positions.title: Infrastructure Engineer
positions.description: Member of IPN Web Services team where we supported 2500+ Linux servers running Apache HTTP and Apache Tomcat. Controlled configuration by Puppet.

positions.title: Infrastructure Analyst
positions.description: Unix / Linux Systems Administrator on GS3 UNIX Linux Team

positions.title: UNIX Systems Administrator
positions.description:
Provide steady state support for production environment containing systems of varied complexity
Maintain server integrity by applying patches and adhering to corporate security standards
Utilized remote hands and eyes for physical server support with direction via IM and phone
Responded to and worked with customers on special requests for work
Collaborate daily with teams across the globe on many tasks and projects 
Design, build, customize both AIX and Red Hat based servers on P and X Series hardware 
Install and configure Tivoli Storage Manager supporting backups
Experienced in the relationship of Servers and SAN storage and supporting architecture
Participated in numerous successful disaster recovery tests for clients
Provide after hours customer and client support on Unix/Linux platforms
Received special education for IBM VIO,  AIX Support 1, 2, 3, and AIX Performance and Capacity

positions.title: Systems Development Intern
positions.description:
Installed, configured, and lightly supported Windows Server 2000, 2003, HP-UX, and Red Hat Servers
Maintained DNS zones and entries ensuring accuracy for future datacenter migration
Assisted and maintained HP Data Protector for client backups
Monitored HP OpenView Operations messages to assist in supporting environment integrity
Produced reports on system capacity and operation aiding capacity planning and purchasing decisions
Introduced to Storage Area Network management and design
Installed HP Storage Essentials agents on Windows, Linux and HP-UX systems
Migrated digital media from file share to Microsoft SharePoint to support disaster recovery

positions.title: IT Intern
positions.description:
Performed network maintenance ensuring proper physical connectivity 
Enterprise desktop, portable hardware, and software support
Utilized Acronis True Image to expedite repair process of systems
Developed Microsoft Access database to provide full inventory of all automated systems
Researched and provided direction with wireless network for 07 Food Show

positions.title: Computer Technician
positions.description:
Repaired and supported computer hardware and software
Facilitated off-site and in-home technical support 
Attended to questions regarding hardware and software
